summary: Small one-church parish. Sat 5:30 PM and Sun 10:00 AM Mass and first-Friday 6:00 PM Adoration are clear in the p2 list. Three questions: the Tuesday and Thursday 9:30 AM Masses move to the rectory in 'winter months' (unspecified), and the Tuesday Adoration after Mass has an end (10:30) but no printed start. Rosaries and the Divine Mercy Chaplet are not recorded.

slots.rationale: The bulletin gives only an end time (10:30 AM) for Adoration after the Tuesday 9:30 Mass; no start time. History stored 10:00-10:30 in two bulletins and 9:30-10:30 in one. A wrong time is worse than a missing one. Reviewer timing rule (2026-10-14): Adoration with no printed start follows the Tuesday 9:30 AM Mass, so it starts 30 minutes later at 10:00 AM; keep the printed 10:30 AM end.
